592008.Description: This turn, you may put an additional card from your hand into your inkwell facedown. Draw a card.
592008.Flavor Text: You need a good plan and even better luck to make it across these treacherous waters.

592009.Description: [Take it for a Spin] 2 Ink — Chosen character of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

592010.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[Think About What's Best] 2 Ink — Draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

592011.Description: [Fall in Line] While you have a character named Mr. Smee in play, this character gets Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
592011.Flavor Text: “Anything for you, Mr. Smee! Except me share o' the plunder...”

592012.Description:
(A character with cost 4 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Your Inventor characters gain Resist +6 this turn. Then, put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 6.)

592013.Description: [Feel the Power] [Exert] — If you have fewer than 3 cards in your hand, draw until you have 3 cards in your hand.

592014.Description:
[Driveling Galoots] This character can't be challenged by Pirate characters.
[Everything Shipshape] While being challenged, your other characters gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

592015.Description: [No Place I'd Rather Be] At the start of your turn, if this card is in your discard, you may play her and she enters play exerted.
592015.Flavor Text: "You can't keep me away from the fun!"

592016.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Prince Naveen.)
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

592017.Description:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Level Up] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.

592019.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
592019.Flavor Text: "Just what we needed—a new place to fight bugs.”

592020.Description: [Guess Who] When this character is banished in a challenge, return this card to your hand.
592020.Flavor Text: “You think you can get rid of me that easy?!”

592021.Description: Put 1 damage counter on chosen character.
592021.Flavor Text: “Don't move. A mosquito has chosen me as her perch. She's so...beautiful.”

592022.Description:
[Symbol of Royalty] Your Prince and King characters gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
[Royal Search] [Exert], 2 Ink — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Prince or King character card, you may put that card into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.

592024.Flavor Text: “Ma'am! I am a highly trained instrument of tactical superiority! Maybe we could find someone else for the groundwork! Ma'am!”

592025.Description: Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
592025.Flavor Text: “Port, Abu! Port! To the left! ABU! The other way!” —Aladdin

592026.Flavor Text:
“Carpet's always come through for us before! He won't let us down now.”
—Jasmine

592027.Description: [Lost in the Waves] Whenever a character is challenged while here, each opponent chooses and discards a card.

592030.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Chip or Dale.)
(This character counts as being named both Chip and Dale.)
[Search and Rescue] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may return a character card from your discard to your hand.

592031.Description: [Special Reservation] Whenever a character of yours is challenged while this character is exerted, the challenging characters gets -3 Strength unless their player pays 3 Ink.

592032.Description:
Shift 7 (You may pay 7 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Rafiki.)
[Astral Attunement] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may draw a card.

592034.Description: [Back, Fools!] Whenever one of your opponents' characters, items, or locations is returned to their hand from play, gain 1 lore.

592036.Description: [Come On, Let's Do This] Once during your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may ready another chosen character of yours. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

592037.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Swash Your Buckles] Whenever you play an action, this character gets +1 Strength and +1 Lore this turn.

592038.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Gadget Hackwrench.)
[Mechanically Savvy] While you have 3 or more items in play, you pay 1 Ink less to play Inventor characters.

592039.Description: [Distant Shores] Whenever one of your Pirate characters quests while at a location, draw a card.
592039.Flavor Text: "The answers we're looking for are on the other side of that maze, I just know it!"

592040.Description: [Distant Shores] Whenever one of your Pirate characters quests while at a location, draw a card.

592998.Flavor Text: Finding your way through the Azurite Sea takes a stout heart, plenty of courage, and more than a little luck.

592999.Description: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)

593000.Description: [You Like Gazelle Too?] While you have a character named Gazelle in play, this character gains Singer 6. (This character counts as cost 6 to sing songs.)

593002.Description: [Captain on Deck] While you have a Captain character in play, this character gets +2 Lore.
593002.Flavor Text: "A promotion! It's about time someone recognized my natural leadership skills!”

593003.Flavor Text: “Of course! It all makes perfect sense. That’s why my old star charts are useless. Every star in the sky here is different!"

593004.Flavor Text: “Strength in numbers is overrated. I prefer my own strength.”

593006.Flavor Text: "For the indecisive sailor we have three, count 'em, three ships in one! It sails, it flies, it juliennes fries! All for the low price of just one wish."

593007.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[What Comes Next?] When you play this character, draw a card.

593008.Description:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

593009.Description: [Soul Collector] During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your other characters is banished, gain 2 lore.
593009.Flavor Text: “You could say I’m big on the catch, not so much on the release.”

593010.Description: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
593010.Flavor Text: Loyal butler, training target, helicopter pilot—and completely unflappable.

593011.Flavor Text: “That maze wasn’t so bad! Let’s see what this island has in store for us.”

593013.Flavor Text: He'll find a way to make anything mouse-sized.

593014.Description: [Come On, Come On, Come On!] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, this character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get +2 Strength while challenging.)

593015.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Jim Hawkins.)
[Battle Stations] When you play this character, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character or location.

593018.Description: [Head Coconut] Whenever this character quests, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card to deal 1 damage to chosen character or location. If you discarded a Pirate character card, deal 3 damage instead.

593019.Description: [Safe and Sound] Whenever this character quests, another chosen character of yours can't be challenged until the start of your next turn.
593019.Flavor Text: “My, you’ve had an awfully big adventure. Now it’s time to rest.”

593020.Description: Your characters get +2 Strength this turn.
593020.Flavor Text: “We have what it takes to find our way through this maze, together! Hold on—we’re going in!”

593022.Description: [We'll Have to Look Into This] Whenever this character quests, you may look at the top card of chosen player's deck. Put it on top of their deck or into their discard.

593023.Description:
Challenger +1 (While challenging, this character gets +1 Strength.)
[Zim Zabberim Bim] Your other characters gain Challenger +1.

593024.Description: Move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character. Draw a card.
593024.Flavor Text:
“That’s got some zang to it!”
—Mama Odie

593025.Flavor Text: “Hoist the colors! Prepare to fight! Teddy bear at the ready!”

593027.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Mickey Mouse.)
[Mariner's Might] Whenever this character quests, chosen Pirate character gets +2 Strength and gains "This character takes no damage from challenges" this turn.

593028.Description: [Land, Ho!] Once during your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may return a location card from your discard to your hand.
593028.Flavor Text: Minnie leaned forward. Could it be true? Was this the island at last?

593029.Description: [Reputation] This character can't be challenged by characters with 2 Strength or greater.

593030.Description: [The Gang's All Here] Once during your turn, whenever you play another character, you may ready this character. He can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.
593030.Flavor Text: "Come on in. Good to see you."

593032.Description: [Make It Sing] 1 Ink, Banish this item — Chosen character counts as having +3 cost to sing songs this turn.
593032.Flavor Text:
“I love this instrument! I strum, everyone dances.”
—Prince Naveen

593033.Flavor Text: She had searched high and low in the Illuminary for any hint of Basil. Instead, she found something completely unexpected . . .

593034.Description:
[Teamwork] For each character you have here, you pay 1 Ink less for the first action you play each turn.
[A Lot to Learn] Whenever you play a second action in a turn, gain 3 lore.

593035.Flavor Text: Pete was always looking for trouble. Now he was finally getting paid for it.

593037.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[Good Boy] While this character has no damage, he gets +4 Strength.

593038.Flavor Text: "Dance little friends—fill the air with light and joy. Achidanza! It is like seeing music come to life."

593039.Description: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
593039.Flavor Text: A clear head and a calm hand will see you through uncharted waters.

593041.Description: Chosen character of yours can't be challenged until the start of your next turn.

593042.Description:
For each Sorcerer character you have in play, you pay 1 Ink less to play this action.
Draw 2 cards.
593042.Flavor Text:
“I see the other half, in the Inklands. Quick, my tiny companion! Fetch me that crown!”
—Jafar

593043.Description: [A Wealth of Happiness] When you play this character, gain 1 lore.
593043.Flavor Text:
"You can learn a lot of things from the flowers . . ."
—Alice

593045.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
593045.Flavor Text: She zips through the waves without a drop of water touching her.

593046.Description: [Give 'Em a Show] At the start of your turn, you may move a character of yours to a location for free.
593046.Flavor Text:
"We've reinvented the very concept of transportation."
—Alistair Krei

593047.Description: [Secret Weapon] At the start of your turn, deal damage to chosen character or location equal to the number of characters here.

593049.Flavor Text:
Raya: “Nothing gets past Tuk Tuk. Nothing.”
Sisu: “Except butterflies! Oh, and birds!”
Raya: “Fine. Most things don’t get past Tuk Tuk.”

593050.Description:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[We're Pirates, You See] Whenever this character quests, you pay 1 Ink less for the next Pirate character you play this turn.

593162.Description: [Secret Weapon] At the start of your turn, deal damage to chosen character or location equal to the number of characters here.
